note: Visual adjudication of mining truth points (scripts/adjudicate_truth.py). verdict: pit | maybe | no_pit | unclear_imagery. 'unclear_imagery' is NOT 'no_pit' - only no_pit removes a positive.

manual_manual_1.note: 2026-08-05 Shelley: Esri z16 contact sheet (analysis/out/adjudicate/manual_z16_0000.png) shows wooded savanna with pale seasonal drainage lines; no pit morphology, spoil heaps or ponds at any of the 8. Esri has NO z18 coverage here ('Map data not yet available'), so z16-17 is the best available and 1-3px hand-dug shafts are below it. Verdict is unclear_imagery, NOT no_pit: cannot see != not there (see docs/MINING_FINDINGS_2026-08.md 8.3).
